config.description: Voice tool for the Movie Room ambient lights (the gradient strips, floor lamps and play bars together). Changes their colour scene or look and turns them on if they are off. Leave scene empty for the next scene, the same as button 4 on the Movie Room scene controller: use that for 'change the ambient lights', 'change the scene', 'next scene' or 'change the mood lighting' in the movie room. scene can also be 'previous', a Hue gradient scene by name (for example sundown, nebula, blue lagoon, blood moon, galaxy, starlight, tokyo, vapor wave, honolulu, emerald isle), a moving effect (fireplace, candle, underwater, cosmos, sparkle, enchant, glisten, opal, sunbeam, sunrise, sunset, colorloop), or red. For brighter or dimmer use Movie Room Ambient Brightness; to turn them off, turn off the Movie Room ambient lights. The tool answers with what it did, or why nothing changed: tell the user that.

scene.name: Scene
scene.description: Empty for the next scene. Or 'previous', a gradient scene name such as sundown or blood moon, an effect such as fireplace or underwater, or red.

sequence.alias: The four gradient lights (Hue Play gradient strips 65/75, left/right Gradient Signe floor lamps) each have a select with the same 75 Hue gradient scenes. The play bars are plain colour lights; script.movie_room_play_bars_match_gradient_scene gives them a colour from the new scene's palette (decoded from Zigbee2MQTT's scene table). Effects go to the Zigbee2MQTT group, which forwards them to all six. A scene change never sends stop_hue_effect: on a Hue gradient light it flattens the gradient to one colour, and a gradient scene (or the play bars' colour) replaces a running effect by itself (read back from the lights' own state, 2026-09-28). Only red, a plain colour, still stops effects first

sequence.alias: A Hue effect resets brightness to full when it starts (zigbee-herdsman-converters philips.js says so, and it jumped to 254 in the 2026-09-28 test), so put the level back once it is running: the current level, or 40 percent if the lights were off

The stop_hue_effect is kept here so Zigbee2MQTT's effect attribute stays honest (it only learns about effects from its own commands); the red colour replaces a running effect anyway, and a stop landing after the red leaves the lights red. On first if needed (the stop is not relied on to turn the lights on)

default.alias: Ambient lights that are off (and only those) come on with a plain turn on (no colour, no effect), which keeps a gradient light's stored gradient: a scene sent to an off light is stored but does not turn it on, and the play bars stay dark if their palette colour misses. Do not add stop_hue_effect here: racing the scene select it landed after the scene and the strips showed the gradient briefly, then one colour (2026-09-28)

result.response: The Movie Room ambient lights are on {{ pretty }} now.

config.description: Voice tool for the Movie Room ambient lights (the gradient strips, floor lamps and play bars together). Makes them brighter or dimmer, like holding button 3 or 4 on the Movie Room scene controller, sets a level, or reads it. Use for 'brighten the ambient lights', 'dim the ambient lights', 'turn the mood lighting up a bit' or 'set the ambient lights to 30 percent' in the movie room. action brighter or dimmer changes the level by percent (15 when no amount is given, 5 for 'a little'); set goes to percent; check reads the level. It never turns them off (the lowest level is 2 percent) and dimmer does not turn them on. For colours, scenes or effects use Movie Room Ambient Scene; to turn them on or off, control the Movie Room ambient lights. The tool answers with what it did, or why nothing changed: tell the user that.

action.name: Action
action.description: brighter or dimmer change the level by percent; set goes to percent; check reads the level.

percent.name: Percent
percent.description: For brighter and dimmer: how much to change by, default 15 (5 for 'a little'). For set: the level, 2 to 100.

sequence.alias: The ambient group is Zigbee2MQTT group 18 (gradient 65/75, left/right Signe floor lamp, play 01/02). A step of 15 percent matches the scene controller's hold (35 of 255 per step); 2 percent is its dim floor (5 of 255)
